title: ToolBench: Facilitating Large Language Models to Master 16000+ Real-World APIs
description: Constructs a benchmark of 16,000+ real REST APIs from RapidAPI, generates instruction-following data for tool use, and trains ToolLLaMA via supervised fine-tuning on GPT-4-generated solutions. Introduces DFSDT (depth-first search decision tree) for solving multi-step tool use problems.
authors: Qin, Liang, Ye, Zhu, Yan, Lu, Lin, Cong, Tang, Qian, et al. (Tsinghua)
